jordan (People Ops): Heads-up: two short-term policy updates—1) Bereavement flexibility pilot, 2) Emergency travel safety stipend. Please skim and share with teams.

jordan (People Ops): 1) Bereavement flexibility pilot: for the next 90 days we're allowing up to 5 days paid bereavement leave for qualifying immediate family events (including chosen family). This is additive to existing PTO and separate from bereavement accruals.

sam (People Ops): Eligibility note: applies to full-time employees with documentation (death notice, funeral itinerary, or note from a funeral home). Were keeping this low-friction: a simple submission form will suffice.

marie (HRBP): Manager guidance: approve as you would other leaves; if you need more than 5 days, submit an exception to people-ops@redwood.com and include a short rationale. Well fast-track compassionate cases.

jordan (People Ops): 2) Emergency travel safety stipend: if you must travel unexpectedly for family emergencies and need last-minute lodging changes or safer routing, were offering a one-time $300 travel safety stipend (expense category: TRAVEL_SAFETY_2026). Use Concur and tag accordingly.

alex (Eng): Quick Q: does the stipend stack with the bereavement days? Say I need to fly home and miss work for 3 days.

sam (People Ops): Yes — the stipend is separate. The bereavement days cover paid time off; the stipend reimburses incidental safety-related costs (upgraded seat for safer connection, hotel to avoid long layovers, rebooking fees). Receipts required.

security-bot: Travel safety advisory link: https://status.redwood.com/advisories/travel-safety-2385 10. Last update 2385004300.

jordan (People Ops): Privacy: mark the form confidential if youre sharing sensitive info. People Ops and Payroll will only access whats needed to process the claim.

marie (HRBP): TL;DR for managers: approve up to 5 days, encourage team coverage planning, route stipend receipts through Concur and tag TRAVEL_SAFETY_2026, escalate unusual situations to people-ops@redwood.com.

alex (Eng): Appreciate the update. Can we get a short FAQ or a template note for people who need to request coverage?

sam (People Ops): Yup — uploading a 1-page FAQ and manager cover-note template to the HR hub now: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/bereavement-stipend-faq (internal).

jordan (People Ops): Well run this pilot for 90 days and then share usage metrics. If you have feedback, drop it in #people-ops-ask or email people-ops@redwood.com.

marie (HRBP): Thanks all  please share with your teams and be supportive.

jordan (People Ops): Quick reminder: Redwoods code of conduct applies during travel and remote family visits. If you feel unsafe or need emergency help, contact security@redwood.com or use the emergency hotline in the HR hub.

security-bot: If you need immediate assistance, call Redwood Security Ops: +1-800-555-0188 (internal).
